subpages.http://convert3d.org/about:
Convert 
3D 
 Convert Model Compress Render View Image to 3D 
About Convert 3D 
 Get in touch 
What is this? 
Convert 3D converts 3D models from a wide range of formats. No need to buy expensive software or install anything. Convert 3D converts between popular formats like FBX and OBJ, but also the lesser known formats you might have received from a coworker or supplier. 
Can you see my files? 
No. Your files never leave your computer when you use Convert 3D. The conversion process happens right in your browser using a technology called Web Assembly . This allows Convert 3D to be as fast or faster than an app installed on your computer or a server in the cloud. 
How can I verify my privacy? 
Pick a converter page, turn off your internet connection and see for yourself that it still works. 
 You can also check the network traffic in e.g. Chrome';s developer tools to verify that your model is never sent to our servers. 
How long does it take to convert a 3D model? 
Less than a second for a simple model. If your model has a lot of polygons, it may take up to a few seconds. 
Why is it free with no ads? What's the catch? 
We are 3D professionals ourselves and we never loved the online converters that upload the 3D models to their server. We see Convert 3D as one way to pay back to the community. 
Who made this? 
Convert 3D is made by Otasha ApS (CVR-46215826), based in Copenhagen, Denmark and Zurich, Switzerland.

Fast and easy video compression 
Quickly convert videos within seconds so you can keep your work flowing. Simply drag and drop your video, and we'll handle the rest. 
Accepted file formats 
Our video compressor reduces the size of almost any video file type, including MP4, AVI, MOV, FLV, and more 
Secure video compression 
We've built this video compression tool to upload and compress your video directly in your browser. Your files will not even leave your device, and nothing will be uploaded to our servers. 
Getting started Restart Video 
 Step 1 : 1. Drag and drop your video file onto this page. 
 Step 2 : 2. We'll start to compress the video right away. No uploading required. 
 Step 3 : 3. Compare the original and compressed video with a side by slide slider. 
 Step 4 : 4. Download your file, and you're good to go. 
Frequently asked questions 
Can I compress my videos for free with Rotato? 
Yes. Any video file type. Select video, compress, and download. Video compression is that simple. 
Will you store my videos online after the compression? 
No. In fact, your file is simply processed to your browser for the sake of compression. We don't, and will not, store anything on our servers. 
Should I compress my videos? 
If there's a need for it. Many of our users need to reduce the size of their files for sharing; usually, they have to upload them to a platform where there's a size limit. Smaller files are also better for storage and for reducing bandwidth usage and costs. 
How does this tool work? 
Our video compressor is powered by FFmpeg, an open-source software for compressing files that has been around for more than two decades. We actually run this right in your browser. No need to install or download any apps. Works on Windows, Mac, Linux and ChromeOS. Our system then uses H.264 algorithms to detect and remove redundant data in your video file, significantly reducing the file size. We also try to lower the bitrate—the amount of data used per second—to further reduce the file size—but only in segments of the video where it is needed and will not affect the quality of the video. 
Some videos get bigger after compression, what's up with that? 
This is most likely because the video is already compressed. Unfortunately, you can only drink a beer once. 
Can I compress videos offline? 
Of course, we've built a desktop version of this tool for those who are always on the go (or have a poor Internet connection). You can download the offline video compressor here. 
What's Rotato? 
We're a platform with a suite of online and offline tools that simplify design work for professionals worldwide. Designers, product managers, and business owners use our product to not only compress files but also create stunning animated mockups of their work to showcase. Check us out.

readmes.mortenjust/native-diffusion:
# Native Diffusion Swift Package
[Join us on Discord](https://discord.gg/XNsw7x667a)
Native Diffusion runs Stable Diffusion models **locally** on macOS / iOS devices, in Swift, using the MPSGraph framework (not Python).
This is the Swift Package Manager wrapper of [Maple Diffusion](https://github.com/madebyollin/maple-diffusion). It adds image-to-image, Swift Package Manager package, and convenient ways to use the code, like Combine publishers and async/await versions. It also supports downloading weights from any local or remote URL, including the app bundle itself. 
Would not be possible without
* [@madebyollin](https://github.com/madebyollin/) who wrote the Metal Performance Shader Graph pipeline
* [@GuiyeC](https://github.com/GuiyeC) who wrote the image-to-image implementation
# Features
Get started in 10 minutes
* Extremely simple API. Generate an image in one line of code. 
Make it do what you want
* Flexible API. Pass in prompt, guidance scale, steps, seed, and an image. 
* One-off conversion script from .ckpt to Native Diffusion's own memory-optimized format
* Supports Dreambooth models. 
Built to be fun to code with
* Supports async/await, Combine publisher and classic callbacks.
* Optimized for SwiftUI, but can be used in any kind of project, including command line, UIKit, or AppKit
Built for end-user speed and great user experience
* 100% native. No Python, no environments, your user don't need to install anything first.
* Model download built in. Point it to a web address with the model files in a zip archive. The package will download and install the model for later use. 
* As fast or faster than a server in the cloud on newer Macs
Commercial use allowed
* MIT Licensed (code). We'd love attribution, but it's not needed legally.
* Generated images are licensed under the [CreativeML Open RAIL-M](https://github.com/CompVis/stable-diffusion/blob/main/LICENSE) license, meaning you can use the images for virtually anything, including commercial use.
# Usage
## One-line diffusion
In its simplest form it's as simple as one line:
```swift
let image = try? await Diffusion.generate(localOrRemote: modelUrl, prompt: "cat astronaut")
```
